summary:
The owner lane in /home/user/ppolppol-fix-owner (uncommitted, base ae505a3) carries out all three owner decisions of 11-12. I found no hard-line break, no crash and no data corruption. On an untouched copy of ae505a3 I reproduced each old behaviour, twice each, and each one is gone on the fixed tree. Every new player-visible situation reuses an existing line, the font check says `stale: none`, and no sound request or AudioContext appeared. The new checks were stable on this loaded machine (load 9-11): Z part 5 passed 5 runs in a row (9/0), Q passed 3 in a row (58/0) and A passed 74/0. npm test exited 0. Each of the fix agent's six mutants fails the check it named; I read all six logs.

There are two findings for the lead and two owner questions:
(1) should/owner: an old save from the current week that already counted "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" as done loses the visible weekly gift. On the base the bag shows 5/5 with the 받기 button and the gift dot. On the fixed tree the same save shows 4/5 with no button and no dot. If the player waits for the week change, last week's gift (조개 12 · 씨앗 2) is not given (35 shells on the base, 23 on the fixed tree). The fix agent noted only the week-change half.
(2) should (test gap): the report says a press during the awake period after a turn still counts. That is true in play, but no check guards it. My mutant `woke = oct.state==='sleep' || S.octopus.state==='sleep'` stops those presses from counting, and Q still passes 58/0.
Owner questions: when a stay-home turn ends while the octopus is upstairs (slow brain, player climbed while it was thinking), the octopus vanishes from the upstairs room instead of staying where it is. And the awake period does not count down while the player is upstairs, so after a turn the octopus cannot come upstairs until the player has watched it nap downstairs and the nap has ended.

Small items: the new-week fallback added in weekState cannot be reached today and no check covers it. A leftover `questMark('gift')` does nothing.

problems.title: Old save that already met 5/5 through the removed task loses the claim button now, and its gift at the week change
problems.where: js/app.js:4366-4376 (weekState: same-week repair and the `due` computation); screen: 살림 › 이번 주 할 일
problems.what: A saved week where 'days' was done (3 visits this week) plus 4 other done tasks showed 5/5 with the 받기 button and the bag-chip gift dot on ae505a3. On the fixed tree the 'days' slot is replaced by a new task at 0, so the list reads 4/5, with no claim button and no dot. A player who had earned the weekly gift and not yet pressed 받기 sees it disappear after the update. If they wait for Monday, the unclaimed gift is not given (the `due` filter skips the unknown slot). The fix agent's report mentions only the week-change half.
problems.evidence: Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-owner/w/p2.js ONLY=C, run twice on each tree. Base: rows include '이번 주에 사흘 들어오기|했어', claim:true, chip 'bag-tag pressable has-gift … 주간 선물이 있어'; next Monday shells 35 seeds 4 prev {12,2}. Fixed: '놀이방 들르기|0/1', claim:false, chip without has-gift; next Monday shells 23 seeds 2 prev undefined. Logs: w/base-p2.log, w/fixed-p2.log and the second runs in this session. Screenshots: w/base-C-bag.png, w/fixed-C-bag.png, w/base2-C-bag.png, w/fixed2-C-bag.png.
problems.suggested_fix: Owner choice. (a) When repairing a 'days' slot, if that week's user.days already reached 3, keep the week's earned count: either count it toward WEEK_NEED in `due` and in the claim check, or give the replacement slot n = its target. Cost: a few lines, and a slot shows 했어 for a task the player did not do. (b) Accept the loss and note it in the docs and OWNER_DECISIONS. It affects only players whose save is from the current week or last week when the update ships. Add a Q check either way.

problems.title: No check guards that a press during the awake period after a turn still counts for 묻기
problems.where: tools/smoke.js Q20 (runs with the awake period at 0); js/app.js:1766
problems.what: Decision 3 says only a press that wakes a napping octopus is not counted. The report says the awake period after a turn counts as awake. The code does this, because `woke` reads the scene state `oct.state` and not the saved `S.octopus.state`, which is 'sleep' for the whole rest period. But Q20 runs with the awake period at 0, so a natural wrong version passes every check. That version tests the saved state, or `restPhase() !== 'up'`.
problems.evidence: Mutant MY1 (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-owner/mut/MY1-wokeSaved) changes the line to `oct.state === 'sleep' || S.octopus.state === 'sleep'`. SMOKE_ONLY=Q gives 58 passed, 0 failed (check-owner/logs/MY1.log). My probe p2.js ONLY=A shows the behaviour change: fixed tree A4 'press in awake window' n=1, MY1 tree n=0.
problems.suggested_fix: Extend Q20, or add Q21, with the awake period above 0: finish a turn, press 산책 갈래? while restPhase() is 'awake' and the octopus is idle, and expect the 묻기 count to rise by one.

problems.title: Octopus vanishes from the upstairs room when a stay-home turn ends there
problems.where: js/app.js:1409-1410 restDown, called from finalPose (1984) and syncRest (1420); loft screen
problems.what: If the player climbs while the brain is still thinking (a real model brain can take many seconds), the octopus follows because it is still awake and idle. When the turn ends as stay-home, restDown moves it to the attic blanket at once, so it disappears in view. The same happens when another tab finishes a turn. The brief said 'never move it', and another 11-12 answer kept 'the octopus stays where it arrived upstairs'.
problems.evidence: p1.js S on the fixed tree: S1 up:true while thinking, then S2 at turn end up:false an:blanket phase:awake. Screenshots w/fixed-S-up-thinking.png and w/fixed-S-up-after.png. Z 5-3 and 5-5 assert this behaviour.
problems.suggested_fix: Owner options. (a) Keep it: rare, and simple. (b) Leave it upstairs until the player goes down (octUnmountLoft already returns it then). The rest period does not count down upstairs anyway. Cost: during that stay the mirror would open the sheet for an octopus in its rest period, unless openSalon also asks restPhase. (c) Walk it down the stairs. Cost: new animation path.

problems.title: The rest period does not count down upstairs, so after a turn the octopus cannot join upstairs until the player has watched it nap downstairs and the nap has ended
problems.where: js/app.js:1350 watching() (11-08 rule), together with octResting
problems.what: After decision 1, a player who goes upstairs right after a turn finds the octopus downstairs for as long as they stay. The awake period, about 1.5 min (25 s if sleepy), only counts down while the player watches the attic. After it the 20-minute nap starts, and during the nap the octopus does not follow either. The only quick way to bring it up is a new invitation, which starts a new rest period. The fix agent flagged this.
problems.evidence: Z 5-1 asserts the timer stays the same for 30 s upstairs. p1 R3 to R5: left 10554 while upstairs, then 13813 on coming down (seen-minimum top-up).
problems.suggested_fix: Owner: either count the upstairs room in watching() (the octopus naps on its own schedule while the player is away), or keep the 11-08 rule.

problems.title: New-week fallback in weekState cannot be reached and no check covers it
problems.what: The `|| QUESTS.filter(...)[0][0]` fallback for a new week never fires today. In the 2D scene with no posters exactly 7 tasks can be dealt ('ask' plus 6), so weekPick never returns ''. If it did fire, it would deal a task that cannot be done right now (questCan is ignored), the same as the existing repair branch. Removing the line fails no check.
problems.evidence: Read of questCan (app.js:4353) and the QUESTS list: furn, loft and diary cannot be dealt in 2D with no posters, which leaves 7 of 10.
problems.suggested_fix: Keep it as a guard with a one-line comment, or drop it. Either way, say in the report that it is defensive code with no check.

problems.title: questMark('gift') is a dead call
problems.what: 'gift' has not been a weekly task since 66c8110. The call does nothing. The fix agent flagged it and left it.
problems.suggested_fix: Remove it at the next touch of that line.

per_fix:
Decision 1 (W3, no following upstairs during the awake period) -> reproduced on base: yes, twice. t5-loft.js ONLY=C: octUp true and the rest period frozen at 11729. p1.js: R3 up:true and the mirror opens the sheet, T3 stays up after the other tab's turn, S2 stays up after a slow turn (w/base-t5C.log, w/base-p1.log). -> gone on fixed: yes. p1 R/T/S: up:false, mirror '지금은 아래층에 있어.' and no sheet, the octopus on the blanket in its awake period; also checked at 320x568 (w/fixed-p1.log, w/fixed320-R-loft-mirror.png). -> guarding checks: climb check -> Z 5-1 to 5-5 (fix agent's M1); restDown in finalPose -> Z 5-3 (M2); restDown in syncRest -> Z 5-5 (M3); octPlace('blanket') inside restDown -> Z 5-5 (my MY2); restPhase rather than `!!rest` -> Z 5-2 (my MY3).
Decision 2 (W4, remove '사흘 들어오기') -> reproduced on base: the row '이번 주에 사흘 들어오기|2/3' is in the list (w/base-p2.log, W0/W1). -> gone on fixed: the old save's slot becomes 'loft' in 3D and 'plant' in a fresh 2D context. The other six slots, seen lists, rr, shells, seeds, user.days and giftDay are unchanged and saved at once; same result after a reload. -> guarding checks: removal -> Q13 and Q19 (M4); save() after the repair -> Q19 (M6); new-week fallback -> none (OW-5). Side effect: OW-1.
Decision 3 (W5, the waking press does not count) -> reproduced on base twice: n=1 after the waking press (w/base-p2.log and this session's run). -> gone on fixed: n=0 after the waking press and the extra presses; a press during the awake period counts (n=1). -> guarding checks: `if (!woke)` -> Q20 (M5); counting during the awake period -> none (OW-2, MY1 survives).

Decision 2: user.days and the day gift line '오늘 선물: 조개 3 · 씨앗 1 (들어온 날 N일째)' are unchanged. The Q checks 10 and 11 now assert the exact line, which is stronger than before. The other Q edits only swap the removed task for 'loft' or 'plant' and keep each check's meaning.

The tree changes only js/app.js, js/scene3d.js, tools/smoke.js, docs/SALON.md and docs/ROOM_EXPANSION.md. No tracked evidence file changed, and no function of another lane was rewritten. The scene got one new optional callback, on.octResting, and octDown is now exposed on the scene API.
Docs (SALON.md §2 and §3.1, ROOM_EXPANSION.md, the QUESTS comment) match the code.
